title: jashne qayam kiye jaaiye dhoom se
body:
jashne qayam kiye jaaiye dhoom se zarre ke sooraj bana dijie
jiski mehfil saji hai wo aajaenge, raah me apni aankhe bicha dijie
<<DIVIDER>>
kar raha hu raqam manqebat aapki, mere aaqa mujhe housla dijie
chaand narjis ke aur askari ke pisar, apne daaman ki mujhko hawa dijie
<<DIVIDER>>
sooni sooni hai har simt raahe'n bohot, muntazir hai ye pyaasi nigaahe'n bohot
inki bechainio par taras khaaiye, pyaas aankho ki fouran bujha dijie
<<DIVIDER>>
hasrate deed qayam hai rakkhe bharam, aye imame zama'n kijie ab karam
karwate'n leti hai deed ki hasrate'n, aaiye ruq se parda utha deejie
<<DIVIDER>>
dekho unki tadap shaahe kouno maka'n, jo hai bechain inka na lo inteha'n
mar chuke ho jo hasrat lie deed ki, unko aawaz dekar jila dijie
<<DIVIDER>>
aap hi se hai qayam ye kouno maka'n , aapke noor se hai ye roshan jaha'n
meri qismat jagaane ab aajaiye, mere ghar ko bhi jannat bana dijie
<<DIVIDER>>
apne shaayar pe keeje nigaahe karam, is jasaarat ka rakhleeje aaqa bharam
ilteja hai ke sunka qasida mera, kuch na kahie faqat muskura dijie
<<DIVIDER>>
zaqm dil ke mai aaqa dikhaau kise, kahie roodaad dil ki sunaau kise
kab se bechain hu de raha hu sada, aaiye dekhie aasra dijie
